title: Make turn-end a legal waiting_on kind and stop orient calling it a blocker
action:
Widen the waiting_on kind vocabulary to three values and teach bee orient the difference (per D3, D4). CONTEXT.md is the authority; cite decisions, never reinterpret them.

PART A — the vocabulary. The one enforced encoding is `pub(crate) const WAITING_ON_KIND_VALUES: [&str; 2] = ["gate", "question"];` at record.rs:356. Add the third value, spelled `turn-end` (lowercase, hyphenated, per CONTEXT.md's Agent's Discretion), APPENDED LAST so the joined rendering reads `gate/question/turn-end`. Appending last is load-bearing — see PART B. The refusal message is built from the constant (record.rs:368-369 does `"waiting_on: kind must be one of {} (got {}).", WAITING_ON_KIND_VALUES.join("/")`), so it re-renders itself; do NOT hand-write a second message. Two other sites read the same constant and need no change but must be re-read to confirm that: record.rs:402 `matches!(m.get("kind"), Some(Value::String(s)) if WAITING_ON_KIND_VALUES.contains(&s.as_str()))` and record.rs:419 another `.join("/")`. Search for the constant by name rather than by line number; the numbers here are anchors that will drift.

PART B — the existing assertions, and a file you must NOT touch. Three tests assert the refusal message with `m.contains("kind must be one of gate/question")`:
  packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/workflow_store/tests.rs:371
  packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/workflow_store/tests.rs:456
  packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/state_group/tests.rs:586
Because PART A appends the new value LAST, `"gate/question/turn-end"` still contains the substring `"gate/question"`, so all three keep passing unchanged. Confirm that by running them; do not weaken or delete them. state_group/tests.rs is RESERVED BY ANOTHER WORKTREE (feature start-feature-reservation-scope, cell sfrs-1) and is deliberately absent from this cell's files — do not edit it, and if your change somehow turns it red, stop and return [BLOCKED] rather than writing through the hold.

Add a positive case in workflow_store/tests.rs proving build_waiting_on ACCEPTS turn-end and round-trips it through the record.

PART C — the orient narrowing (per D4). In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/status_full/orient.rs, find the block whose comment begins `// D1 (awaiting-human): a live wait is a BLOCKER here` (near line 395) and whose body is `if opt_truthy(status.get("waiting_on")) { ... blockers.push(json!(format!("awaiting human — {}: {}", ...))) }`. Narrow it so a mark whose kind is turn-end is NOT pushed into blockers. A turn-end is by definition not a blocker (D4). Do NOT touch the display path that echoes waiting_on into the orient packet's `where.waiting_on` field (near line 495) — display surfaces keep showing all three kinds (D4). Update the block's comment so the next reader sees why the exception exists, citing auto-wait-mark D4. Add a test in status_full/tests.rs proving a turn-end mark is absent from blockers, beside the existing `orient_reports_a_live_wait_as_a_blocker_naming_the_subject` (near line 3763) which must keep passing for a question mark.

PART D — the prose. Source docs spell the vocabulary as two values; update each to three, and say in one line what turn-end means (control is back with the human, nothing is owed):
  docs/knowledge/areas/workflow-state/workflow-records-and-projections.md:432-433  `build_waiting_on(kind, subject, session)` validates a closed two-value / `kind` (`gate`/`question`) ...
  docs/knowledge/areas/workflow-state/workflow-records-and-projections.md:603      R125 — `waiting_on` is `null` (no live wait) or an object with `kind` in ...
  skills/bee-hive/references/routing-and-contracts.md:318-319                       `bee state waiting-on set --kind <gate|question> --subject "<the question>"`
  packages/bee/AGENTS.block.md:166-167                                             `bee state waiting-on set --kind <gate|question> --subject "<what>"`
AGENTS.md carries the same two lines but is GENERATED from packages/bee/AGENTS.block.md — edit the block, never AGENTS.md by hand. Likewise every file under .claude/skills/ is a generated mirror of skills/. Search for any further `<gate|question>` spelling you find rather than trusting this list to be complete; report any extra hit in the trace.

PART E — regen and manifest. After the edits run `.bee/bin/bee dev regen` so AGENTS.md, the .claude/skills mirrors, and generated/registry_payload.json (which carries the --kind CLI help text) all re-render, then `.bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check`.

bee orient omits a turn-end mark from its blockers array while still reporting gate and question marks there
bee orient still echoes a turn-end mark under where.waiting_on — the display path is untouched
No file in .claude/skills/ or AGENTS.md is hand-edited; both re-render from their sources via bee dev regen

a case proving a turn-end mark is absent from blockers, beside the existing case proving a question mark is present
